name: edge-source-no-branch
title: Edge case: one source of two takes no branch
description: An edge-case fixture (#1543, ruling 3): the deliverable note reads the node summary, which always runs, and the case letter_case, which takes no branch when the route is none, so 30 skips note though summary ran; summary_note, from the problem loop and summary, keeps the start from being refused. Fictional; not intended for clinical use.
